thread:
Kevin (Support): FYI escalating to CS — VentureScale onboarding failing during provisioning after an API key rotation. Seen by multiple users, ticket P1, renewal in ~10 days. 403 from /v1/provision. Tagging @Maria and @Emily.

Maria (CS): Ack. Can you paste the error payload and the customer org id? Need to assess renewal risk and craft comms.

Kevin (Support): Org: venturescale-prod. Error from logs: 
```
2026-03-21T14:02:11Z ERROR request_id=abc123 status=403 msg="forbidden: invalid api key" endpoint=/v1/provision model=embed-1
user_id=ue_9876 session=provisioning
```
They rotated keys yesterday but we expected a seamless handoff. Affected: ingest and embeddings creation. No data loss reported.

Alex (SE): This looks like the new key wasn't propagated to the provisioning service (env var `REDWOOD_API_KEY`). Quick workaround for customer: re-run `rdwctl provision --api-key <new_key>` on their side, or we can trigger a backfill from our side if they prefer.

Emily (CSM): I'll own the customer comms. Need a short timeline and who will call them. Also need a mitigation plan before renewal conversation.

Maria (CS): Owners: Kevin/support = triage & logs, Alex/SE = workaround script + permission check, Emily = customer comms + renewal owner update. ETA for initial remediation?

Kevin (Support): Triage in progress, I can confirm if key present on provisioning nodes in ~30m. Filed internal incident: <https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-128> (OncallBot created).

OncallBot: Incident INC-2026-128 created by Kevin (Support). Priority: P1. Links: runbook and pager.

Alex (SE): Quick verification steps for engineers: 
```bash
# check env on pods
kubectl -n infra exec -it provisioner-0 -- printenv | grep REDWOOD_API_KEY
# attempt a signed test provision call using the new key
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEW_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -d '{"org":"venturescale-prod","model":"embed-1"}'
```
If 403 persists, rollback suggestion: re-add old key temporarily.

Maria (CS): Comms plan (draft):
- Goal: reassure + give mitigation steps + timeline.
- Who: Emily lead comms (email + scheduled 30m call), Alex to join for live triage if they want.
- Message: apologize, explain root-cause (key propagation mismatch), steps we're taking, temporary workaround (re-run provision or allow us to backfill), ETA for full resolution: 4-6 hours.
- Renewal note: flag to renewals team that there may be friction; Emily to update renewal owner after incident summary.

Emily (CSM): I'll send the first email in 20m. Draft snippet: "We're sorry — you've hit a provisioning error after a key rotation. We're treating this as a P1 and will either run a backfill or guide you through a quick re-provision. ETA ~4 hours. I'll be on the call at 15:00 PT." Will post draft here for review.

Kevin (Support): Quick ask for logs retention: keep the provisioning logs and request IDs for 30 days; might be needed for postmortem.

Maria (CS): Agreed. After resolution, we'll run a brief customer-facing postmortem and share a short mitigation plan (improve key propagation checks + alerting).

Jordan (Product): Tagging for follow-up: can we add a readiness check to the key rotation flow? Low-risk improvement but prevents renewals friction.

Emily (CSM): Draft email posted. Kevin/Alex pls ack and I'll send.

Kevin (Support): Ack. I'll confirm node env in 15m and update.

Alex (SE): Ack. If anyone needs a direct line, ping me — I'll be on standby. :headphones:

Maria (CS): Thanks team. We'll reconvene in this thread with the remediation status and then finalize the comms + renewal update.
